subject: MSA / Order Form redlines — IP defense ownership & evidence relay
messages:
From: Alex Chapman <alex.chapman@lumos.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@lumos.ai
Date: 2025-11-24 09:12 -0800
Subject: Lumos redlines: MSA + Order Form (IP defense / evidence requirements)

Marissa / Ben — attaching our redlines for the MSA and the Order Form (see Lumos_Redlines_20251124.pdf). A few quick asks up front so we can keep procurement moving: 

- We need clarity on who "controls" third-party IP defense when an allegation is about output generated by your models. Lumos prefers supplier-led defense with a reimbursement path, but our procurement team wants explicit evidence custody and a named technical contact.
- Please confirm the evidence preservation timeline (we request 90 days from notice) and whether Redwood will provide a forensics capture (logs, model id, KV cache snapshot).
- On caps: Lumos is asking that indemnity for third-party IP is capped at the Order Form value, but legal will accept a carveout for willful infringement or gross negligence.

We have a procurement review call Wednesday 2025-11-26 at 10am PT; would be helpful to have Redwood's proposed language before then.

Attachments: Lumos_Redlines_20251124.pdf (redlines), evidence_checklist.xlsx (reference)

Thanks,
Alex Chapman
Head of Procurement, Lumos AI

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chapman <alex.chapman@lumos.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-24 11:07 -0800
Subject: Re: Lumos redlines: MSA + Order Form (IP defense / evidence requirements)

Alex — thanks for the redlines and the heads-up on the procurement calendar. Looping in Kim and Jordan from Legal so we can get a proposed counter-language on the evidence custody, notice windows, and cap carveouts.

High-level from product/sales perspective (Ben and I chatted briefly):
- We can commit to a documented "technical evidence liaison" who will accept requests for preserved artifacts (logs, model id, request payloads). We need to clarify the scope — e.g., do you want raw input/output payloads or a sanitized extract?
- Redwood's standard preservation window is 60 days for ephemeral traces; we can extend to 90 days for customers on Enterprise order forms with an evidence-handling SLA (we'd want that reflected in the Order Form).
- Regarding defend vs. reimburse: Redwood's preference is to lead defense when the allegation is about Redwood's model code or hosting; for customer-provided prompts/data we typically offer reimbursement except for willful misconduct.

Kim / Jordan — can you propose tidy redline language that: (1) names a technical liaison and evidence custodian; (2) sets a 90-day capture window as optional for Enterprise; (3) clarifies defend-vs-reimburse split and carveouts for gross negligence/willful infringement?

Proposed next steps: legal redline by EOD Monday (2025-11-25), internal review Tuesday AM, sync with Lumos procurement before their Wed call if possible. Ben will act as commercial owner on the call.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Chapman <alex.chapman@lumos.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-25 16:22 -0800
Subject: RE: Lumos redlines: MSA + Order Form (IP defense / evidence requirements)

Marissa / Alex — attaching draft language (redwood_proposed_clause.docx). High level comments below; please consider these my working assumptions and we can adjust based on risk appetite/commercials.

1) Evidence custody & liaison
- We will designate a "Technical Evidence Liaison" at Redwood (name and contact to be added in the Order Form annex). Redwood will retain and provide preserved artifacts reasonably requested by the customer or Redwood's counsel in connection with a claim. Requests must be specific and tied to a notice of claim.

2) Preservation window
- Base preservation window: 60 days from notice. Optional enterprise addendum: 90-day retention for an additional fee or as set out in the Order Form. We can accommodate a 90-day window in this deal if Lumos agrees to the enterprise Order Form pricing (suggested commercial concession: 10% uplift on committed spend).

3) Defend vs. Reimburse allocation
- Redwood will defend and control third-party IP claims arising from (a) the Service (infrastructure, model code provided by Redwood), and (b) model outputs where Redwood's fine-tuning or model modifications are the proximate cause.
- Customer will be responsible for claims arising from customer-supplied prompts, data, or instructions that materially contribute to the infringement.
- Exceptions: willful misconduct or gross negligence will not be restricted by the split above.

4) Cap / Insurance
- Proposed cap on Redwood's indemnity: aggregate equal to the Order Form value, except for willful misconduct/gross negligence. Redwood requests: (a) that Lumos maintain commercially reasonable insurance; and (b) mutual cooperation in any settlement.

5) Evidence production mechanics
- For forensic artifacts we will provide logs and model identifiers. Raw customer data will only be produced pursuant to a valid subpoena or with customer consent. We can provide sanitized extracts to speed triage.

If Lumos can confirm they can accept the enterprise addendum or a 10% uplift for the 90-day window, Legal can finalize a clean clause and an Order Form annex.

Attachments: redwood_proposed_clause.docx

—Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
